title: Chart the Invisible: Interactive Perception for Hidden-Target Exploration in GUI Agents
why: Adds scrollable-region perception (Hagasu) so GUI agents swipe to reveal viewport-hidden targets before acting.
mechanism: Perception/action: multimodal scrollable-region detector on 667 UI screens (Hagasu) guides when/where/how to swipe before click, targeting explore-dependent GUI tasks with hidden off-viewport content
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: Hagasu identifies 78.5% scrollable regions; across nine GUI agents mean end-to-end completion on explore-dependent tasks rises 64.8%→82.7%. Numbers from abstract — not independently verified.

title: iPrefBench: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personalized Mobile Use Agents
why: Executable iOS bench for personalized mobile-use agents that must infer history vs ask underspecified prefs.
mechanism: Evaluation: personalization for mobile computer-use — history-inferable vs ask-only omitted requirements in executable iOS env with interactive simulated user (persona + past activity)
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: 130 underspecified tasks / 26 apps / 3,051 past events; agents reach high non-personalized completion (up to 95.6%) but low full personalized success (up to 47.7%), especially weak on ask-only. From abstract — unverified.

title: SkillLifeBench: Benchmarking Security Across the Lifecycle of Agent Skills
why: Web-agent skill lifecycle security bench linking code/version/runtime divergence to task vs attack outcomes.
mechanism: Evaluation/safety for web agents: paired scenarios where skill stored code, selected version, and loaded implementation diverge; joint success = task done without registered attack goal; provenance aids recovery
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: 388 paired scenarios; 89 runtime + 60 lifecycle tasks; GPT-5.6-Sol/Sonnet 4.6 both 82.0% runtime but 96.7%/56.7% lifecycle; joint success 65.2% with 103 runs completing attack too. From abstract — unverified.

title: Harness-Model Collaboration for Long-Horizon Continual Learning
why: HaMo pairs harness experience cards with model continual learning for long-horizon web-agent workflows.
mechanism: Training/memory for web agents: non-parametric strategy-level experience cards for immediate retrieval + experience-conditioned continual learning so the model grounds and executes retrieved strategies under domain shift
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: HaMo beats harness-only and model-only under within- and cross-domain shifts on retention and adaptation. Abstract lacks numeric table — unverified.
